code:
import numpy as np, requests, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, networkx as nx
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
     'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_atoms(t):
    out=[]
    for ln in t.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[16] in (" ","A"):
            el=(ln[76:78].strip() or ln[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
            if el=="H": continue
            out.append((int(ln[22:26]),ln[12:16].strip(),AA3.get(ln[17:20].strip(),"X"),
                        np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])]),el))
    return out
def af_atoms(acc):
    j=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=120).json()
    e=[x for x in j if x["entryId"]==f"AF-{acc}-F1"][0]
    return parse_atoms(requests.get(e["pdbUrl"],timeout=250).text)
AT={k:af_atoms(v) for k,v in {"LONRF1":"Q17RB8","LONP1":"P36776","LONP2":"Q86WA8","EcLon":"P0A9M0"}.items()}
RAD={"C":1.7,"N":1.55,"O":1.52,"S":1.8,"SE":1.9}; HYD=set("AVLIMFWCY")
def sasa(atoms):
    X=np.array([a[3] for a in atoms]); R=np.array([RAD.get(a[4],1.7) for a in atoms])+1.4
    g=(1+5**0.5)/2; k=np.arange(92); z=1-2*(k+.5)/92; r=np.sqrt(1-z**2)
    sph=np.stack([np.cos(2*np.pi*k/g)*r,np.sin(2*np.pi*k/g)*r,z],1)
    D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None],axis=-1); out=np.zeros(len(X))
    for i in range(len(X)):
        nb=np.where((D[i]<R[i]+R.max())&(np.arange(len(X))!=i))[0]
        pts=X[i]+R[i]*sph; acc=np.ones(92,bool)
        if len(nb): acc=~(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None]-X[nb][None],axis=-1)<R[nb]).any(1)
        out[i]=4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
rows=[]
for lab,p,lo,hi,kind in [("LONRF1 Lon-N","LONRF1",558,768,"test"),("EcLon Lon-N","EcLon",11,204,"reference"),
                         ("LONP2 Lon-N","LONP2",13,222,"reference"),("LONRF1 TPR array","LONRF1",212,312,"control"),
                         ("LONP1 proteolytic","LONP1",759,949,"control")]:
    at=[a for a in AT[p] if lo<=a[0]<=hi]; s=sasa(at); per={}
    for a,v in zip(at,s): per[(a[0],a[2])]=per.get((a[0],a[2]),0)+v
    tot=sum(per.values()); hyd=sum(v for (r,aa),v in per.items() if aa in HYD)
    exp=[(r,aa) for (r,aa),v in per.items() if aa in HYD and v>30]
    coord={a[0]:a[3] for a in at if a[1]=="CB" or (a[1]=="CA" and a[2]=="G")}
    P=np.array([coord[r] for r,aa in exp if r in coord])
    G=nx.from_numpy_array((np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None],axis=-1)<8.0).astype(int))
    rows.append(dict(domain=lab,kind=kind,n_res=len(per),frac_hydrophobic_SASA=round(hyd/tot,3),
                     exposed_hydrophobic_res=len(exp),largest_patch=max(len(c) for c in nx.connected_components(G))))
sas=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(sas.to_string(index=False)); sas.to_csv("artifacts/LonN_hydrophobic_surface.csv",index=False)

tm=pd.DataFrame([["LONRF1 Lon-N vs E. coli Lon N",0.839,"test"],["LONRF2 Lon-N vs LONRF1 Lon-N",0.989,"paralog"],
                 ["LONRF1 Lon-N vs LONP2 Lon-N",0.706,"test"],["LONP2 Lon-N vs E. coli Lon N",0.820,"positive control"],
                 ["LONP1 Lon-N vs E. coli Lon N",0.204,"positive control (fails)"],
                 ["LONRF1 Lon-N vs LONP1 Lon-N",0.214,"test (uninformative)"],
                 ["LONRF1 Lon-N vs LONP1 proteolytic",0.167,"negative control"],
                 ["LONRF1 TPR vs LONP1 Lon-N",0.212,"negative control"]],columns=["pair","TM","kind"])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,5.4))
c={"test":"#2b7a3d","paralog":"#2b7a3d","positive control":"#3b6ea5","positive control (fails)":"#c23b22",
   "test (uninformative)":"#c23b22","negative control":"#999999"}
tm=tm.sort_values("TM")
ax[0].barh(tm.pair,tm.TM,color=[c[k] for k in tm.kind],edgecolor="k",lw=.5)
ax[0].axvline(0.5,ls="--",c="k"); ax[0].text(0.51,0.2,"TM 0.5: same fold",fontsize=9)
for y,(v,) in enumerate(zip(tm.TM)): ax[0].text(v+0.01,y,f"{v:.3f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlim(0,1.08); ax[0].set_xlabel("TM-score (sequence-independent structural alignment)")
ax[0].set_title("The LONRF1 C-terminal domain is a genuine Lon N-terminal fold\n(179 residues under 5 A at 1.89 A RMSD vs E. coli Lon)",fontsize=11)
ax[0].grid(axis="x",alpha=.3)
x=np.arange(len(sas)); cc={"test":"#2b7a3d","reference":"#3b6ea5","control":"#999999"}
ax[1].bar(x,sas.frac_hydrophobic_SASA*100,color=[cc[k] for k in sas.kind],edgecolor="k",lw=.5)
for i,(f,pch) in enumerate(zip(sas.frac_hydrophobic_SASA,sas.largest_patch)):
    ax[1].text(i,f*100+0.4,f"{f*100:.1f}%\npatch {pch}",ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(sas.domain,rotation=20,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("hydrophobic fraction of solvent-accessible surface (%)")
ax[1].set_ylim(0,36)
ax[1].set_title("Exposed hydrophobic surface does not separate the domains:\nthe metric is not diagnostic of substrate binding",fontsize=11)
ax[1].grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
